services.name: SceneResource_RunState10Presentation
services.behavior: Prepares VDP control and palette source 0x00129812, clears the state-10 fill offset, initializes the render-frame service, and interprets the command stream at 0x00127834. While resource status remains clear, runs up to 300 iterations of AnimationVM, MovementVM, actor-only records, VBlank wait, state-10 VDP fill progression, and both sprite submissions before fading and releasing actor resources.

evidence.dispatch: SceneResource_Dispatch calls 0x001B4D0C only in its SCENE_STATE=10 branch after loading the state-10 VRAM pair and checking SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS.
evidence.command_stream: The routine publishes SCENE_COMMAND_STREAM_CURSOR from ROM 0x00127834, marks the command-stream phase with 0x00FFEFFC, and invokes SceneResource_ProcessCommandStream before the recurring service loop.
evidence.service_loop: The loop tests SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS, runs 300 DBF iterations, increments FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER, and writes VDP_DATA from STATE10_VDP_FILL_OFFSET on every qualifying phase until the offset reaches 0x20.

limitations: The user-facing identity of the state-10 presentation and command stream remains unresolved; this finding records the state-specific resource/service contract only.
No new runtime trace was required because the caller branch, fixed ROM sources, loop bound, and cleanup path are explicit in the decompile.
conclusion: The state-10 dispatcher branch now has a named presentation service distinct from the generic scene-resource command interpreter and shared VBlank/render helpers.
